description: Demolition of existing staff accommodation buildings and redevelopment of the site to provide 141 key worker flats (53 x studios, 78 x 1-bed and 10 x 2-bed units) in a part 6, part 8 and part 9 storey building.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - Sample panels of all facing materials, including but not limited to the following shall be submitted for approval prior to commencement of construction of the approved development:

a.	The proposed brickwork showing the brick type, colour, bond, mortar mix, joint width ad pointing types; 

b.	All other proposed external facing materials including rendered panels, aluminium spandrels, glass balustrades and steel balconies.

An approved sample panel shall be provided on site and the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approval of materials given.  The sample panel shall be retained on site until the development has been completed.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1, EN13 and EN37 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000, and policies B1, B2 and B7 of the Revised London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2004.

Condition : 3 - The details of the approved external timber cladding to be used on the development shall not be other as shall have been submitted to and approved by the Council before any work is commenced on the relevant part of the development.  Such details shall include the colour and type of the cladding, and details regarding its weathering capabilities specifically to ensure the cladding material will retain its colour and appearance in the long term.  The timber cladding shall not be implemented otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1, EN13 and EN37 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000, and policies B1, B2 and B7 of the Revised London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2004.

Condition : 4 - All trees on the site, or parts of trees growing from adjoining sites, unless shown on the approved drawings as being removed, shall be retained and protected from damage to the satisfaction of the Council for a period of at least 5 years following the completion of the development hereby approved, or such longer period as may be required under Sections 198 and 211 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.  In particular, details shall be submitted to the Council before works commence on site to demonstrate how the trees at the southern boundary of the site bordering the Belsize Wood Open Space (incl. Plane, lime and ash) shall be protected during construction work.  Such details shall for instance include measures to protect the tree trunk, to prevent additional soil compaction around the root zone and to reduce damage to the lower branches including any proposals for crown uplifting.

Reason: To ensure that the Council may be satisfied that the development will not have any adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenities of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN52, EN56 and EN61 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000, and policies N5 and N7 of the Revised London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2004.

Condition : 5 - Details of replanting species, position, date ad size where applicable shall be submitted to the Council's Tree Preservation Officer for approval written approval.  The approved replanting scheme shall be implemented within 12 months of the first residential occupation of the building.  Any new trees that die within 5 years of their being planted shall be replaced within the next planting season.

Reason: To ensure that the Council may be satisfied that the development will not have any adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenities of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN52, EN56 and EN61 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000, and policies N5 and N7 of the Revised London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2004.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until full details of hard and soft landscaping and means of enclosure of all unbuilt areas, and provision of pedestrian access strips ensuring safe access to the building by pedestrians have been submitted to and approved by the Council.  Such details shall include any proposed earthworks including grading, mounding and other changes in ground levels.

Reason: To enable the Council to ensure a reasonable standard of visual amenity and pedestrian safety in the scheme in accordance with the requirements of policies RE3, EN15, EN37 and TR21 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000, and policies B2 and T3 of the Revised London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2004.

Condition : 7 - Details demonstrating how the area shown on the approved plans as providing cycle storage will provide for not less than 30 bicycles shall be submitted to and approved the Council.  The approved cycle storage shall be provided in its entirely prior to the first residential occupation of the building and retained permanently thereafter for the exclusive use of  residents of the building.

Reason: To ensure adequate provision of cycle storage in accordance with the requirements of policy TR22 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000, and policy T3 of the Revised London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2004.

Condition : 8 - Typical details of the proposed green roof, in the form of a section through the roof showing the depth of organic material and drainage system shall be submitted for approval prior to the commencement of construction works. The development shall not be implemented otherwise than in accordance with the approved details and retained permanently thereafter.

Reason: To ensure the proposed green roof is functional and sustainable in preserving the habitat value of the site and mitigating the adverse effects on runoff of the additional built space in accordance with the requirements of policies EN9 and EN60 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000, and policy SD9 of the Revised London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2004.

Condition : 9 - The approved green roof must be implemented prior to the first residential occupation of the development.

Reason: To ensure the proposed green roof preserves the habitat value of the site and mitigates the adverse effects on runoff of the additional built space in accordance with the requirements of policies EN9 and EN60 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000, and policy SD9 of the Revised London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2004.
